summary: Enhance your economic modeling skills with our comprehensive training on Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium (DSGE) modeling. Join us today!
lede: DSGE modelling uses structural economic models to examine macroeconomic fluctuations and policy scenarios. For quantitative professionals and researchers working on macroeconomic forecasting or policy analysis, the course develops practical skills for building and assessing these models. Participants derive and log-linearize equilibrium conditions, implement and simulate models in Dynare, estimate parameters using macroeconomic time-series data, and interpret impulse responses, shock decompositions, and forecasts.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for quantitative professionals and researchers who are responsible for macroeconomic forecasting, policy simulation, and structural economic analysis.
modules: Foundations of DSGE and RBC Models
Solving and Simulating Models in Dynare
prerequisites: Participants must have a solid foundation in macroeconomic theory, differential calculus, and basic time-series econometrics. Prior exposure to MATLAB, Octave, or similar programming environments is highly recommended. Participants must bring a laptop with MATLAB installed; instructions for installing the open-source Dynare package will be provided prior to the course.
